procedural_matters: SLO 163672 did not come to the hearing, the hearing proceeded in accordance with RRS 63.1(b).
facts: AUT 219936 on starboard and SLO 163672 on port on the beat to windward on converging courses.
As boats approaches each other both boats luffed and tacked with minimum distance 30 cm between the hulls.
No contact occurred. No boat took penalty turns.
conclusions: SLO 163672 on port tack failed to keep clear of AUT 219936 on starboard tack, and broke RRS 10.
decision: SLO 163672 is DSQ in race no. 3.
